newsitem.title: INDIA: Two killed in India as police fire on mob.
newsitem.headline: Two killed in India as police fire on mob.

text.p: Two villagers were killed in central India when police fired on a mob which threw stones in protest against the acquisition of village land for a coal mine project, the United News of India (UNI) said on Tuesday.
The news agency said the incident took place on Monday night at Kusumunda near the town of Korba, 500 km (310 miles) east of Bhopal, capital of the state of Madhya Pradesh.
